author: SickProdigy
description: Interactive staff browsing, search, filtering, and summaries over Red ModLog cases.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server role IDs used for staff access. It does not copy or own moderation case data; case data is read from Red ModLog.
install_msg: Load Red's ModLog, then use `[p]incidents` for the staff dashboard and `[p]incidentset` to grant additional staff roles access.
name: Incidents
short: Interactive staff reporting over existing Red ModLog cases.
